text:
Maya: Hey team — Nightjar reached out asking for a short-term subnet peering & per-route throughput bump for an APAC sales demo next week. They also mentioned they'll want a renewal discussion after the pilot. Need enablement + short-term config change. 🎯
Ethan: timeline? which APAC region and CIDRs?
Maya: demo window Tue 10am SGT -> they need 500 qps for 90m. Region: ap-southeast-1. CIDRs: 198.51.100.0/24 (app), 198.51.101.0/28 (dev). Customer team email: ops@nightjar.ai
Priya: noted — renewal flag: trial ends in 3 weeks; churn risk if demo fails. recommend enabling a temporary burst with auto-revoke + schedule a pre-demo enablement call. Can we do a 72-hr window?
Jordan: infra ok to provision peering. I'll need the exact CIDRs and which routes to pin. Also confirm whether they need TLS passthrough or proxy (we prefer proxy for observability).
Maya: proxy required. Can we pin at route-level for proxy: /v1/generate only? They want logs retained for 7 days.
Jordan: ok. Config I will apply (example):
```json
{
  "customer": "nightjar",
  "region": "ap-southeast-1",
  "routes": ["/v1/generate"],
  "cidrs": ["198.51.100.0/24","198.51.101.0/28"],
  "temp_window": {"start":"2025-05-06T02:00:00Z","end":"2025-05-09T02:00:00Z"},
  "qps": 500,
  "audit_retention_days": 7
}
```
Ethan: FYI we'll also need a per-customer rate-limit override on the control plane: route-level + token. Priya can you confirm billing contact to approve overage for demo?
Priya: billing contact confirmed: finance@nightjar.ai. I'll send an approval email now and capture the approval in Zendesk ticket #NZ-9182. Also scheduling enablement call Tue 8am SGT — invite sent.
InfraBot: Deploy plan created: peering-request/nightjar-ap-southeast-1-3498761230. Runbook: /runbooks/peering-temp. Auto-revoke job scheduled for 2025-05-09T02:05:00Z.
Jordan: applying ACLs now, will post when complete.
Jordan: done — peering in place, proxy route pinned, qps override active. Logs: https://console.redwood/ops/logs?ticket=NZ-9182 :thumbsup:
Maya: thanks! Priya — do we want a post-demo health check 24h after to capture feedback and any QoS regressions for the renewal conversation?
Priya: yes. I'll run the health check and capture metrics (p95 latency, error rate, token cost delta) and add notes to the renewal playbook.
Ethan: one more: Nightjar asked if we can pre-warm KV cache for a set of prefixes. Jordan, any way to pre-seed?
Jordan: we can pre-warm by sending synthetic warmup traffic to /v1/generate with their prefix set. I'll run a script after peering is up. Command:
```
./tools/warm_cache.sh --host nightjar-proxy.ap-southeast-1 --prefixes file://nightjar-prefixes.txt --rate 200
```
Maya: perfect. I'll update the customer thread and close out once post-demo health check is done. ✅
